indicators.label: Population (GHSL, primary)
indicators.native_grain: 30 arc-second raster (about 0.93 km at the equator), WGS84; JRC's own resampling of the 100 m / 1 km Mollweide product
lineage: Read the 30 arc-second raster over the window (+0.1° pad)
Assign each pixel to the H3 res-6 cell containing the pixel centre
Sum pixel populations per cell
indicators.caveat: Modelled residential population for 2020. Not a count. Pixel-centre assignment means cells on the edge of a dense town can gain or lose a few hundred people relative to an exact area-weighted split.

indicators.label: Population (WorldPop, secondary)
lineage: Read the 30 arc-second raster over the window (+0.1° pad)
Assign each pixel to the H3 res-6 cell containing the pixel centre
Sum pixel populations per cell
indicators.caveat: Constrained product: people are placed only where settlement is mapped, so many rural cells are empty here but not in GHSL. National totals are adjusted to UN estimates.

indicators.label: Population disagreement (WorldPop vs GHSL)
lineage: Take pop.ghsl and pop.worldpop for the cell
Skip cells where both are below 100 people
Compute (WorldPop - GHSL) / mean(WorldPop, GHSL) x 100
indicators.caveat: A measure of how far two reputable models disagree, not of which is right. Positive means WorldPop places more people here than GHSL.

indicators.label: Urban population share (GHS-SMOD)
indicators.native_grain: 30 arc-second raster (about 0.93 km), WGS84; JRC's resampling of the native 1 km Mollweide grid
lineage: Read the 30 arc-second raster over the window (+0.1° pad)
Assign each pixel to the H3 res-6 cell containing the pixel centre
Weight each pixel by its GHS-POP 2020 population (same grid)
Urban share = population in urban centres (class 30) + urban clusters (21-23), over all non-water population
indicators.caveat: Degree of Urbanisation classes are a harmonised international definition, not national definitions of 'urban'. The inspector shows the urban centre / urban cluster / rural split.

indicators.label: Travel time to nearest health facility, motorised
lineage: Request the 30 arc-second WCS subset for the window (+0.5° pad)
Assign each pixel to the H3 res-6 cell containing the pixel centre
Weight each pixel by GHS-POP 2020 sampled at the pixel centre (nearest pixel)
Population-weighted mean per cell; unweighted mean where nobody lives
indicators.caveat: Modelled best-case travel time assuming motorised transport is available. Says nothing about facility quality, staffing, cost or opening hours. The inspector shows the within-cell minimum and maximum, which is spread, not uncertainty.

indicators.label: Travel time to nearest health facility, walking only
lineage: Request the 30 arc-second WCS subset for the window (+0.5° pad)
Assign each pixel to the H3 res-6 cell containing the pixel centre
Weight each pixel by GHS-POP 2020 sampled at the pixel centre (nearest pixel)
Population-weighted mean per cell; unweighted mean where nobody lives
indicators.caveat: Modelled walking time with no vehicle. Same facility list and caveats as the motorised layer.

indicators.label: Years since the last population census
lineage: Transcribe the most recent completed census per country from the UNSD page
Years since = 2026 - census year
Attach to every cell that a country's geoBoundaries outline covers (at least 1% of the cell)
A cell covered by two or more outlines shows the country covering most of it; the inspector lists the others
indicators.caveat: A national fact spread over every cell, so it is the same for a capital and a remote valley. It matters because every population model above is anchored to these censuses.

ghsl_pop_2020.name: GHS-POP R2023A, epoch 2020
ghsl_pop_2020.citation: Schiavina M., Freire S., Carioli A., MacManus K. (2023): GHS-POP R2023A - GHS population grid multitemporal (1975-2030). European Commission, Joint Research Centre. doi:10.2905/2FF68A52-5B5B-4A22-8F40-C41DA8332CFE
ghsl_pop_2020.native_grain: 30 arc-second raster (about 0.93 km at the equator), WGS84; JRC's own resampling of the 100 m / 1 km Mollweide product
ghsl_pop_2020.grade_notes: Modelled from census counts disaggregated onto built-up surface. No per-pixel interval is published. Recency is lowered per cell where the country's census inputs are old (see kno.census_age).

worldpop_2020.name: WorldPop Global2 R2025A, 2020, constrained, UN-adjusted, 1 km
worldpop_2020.licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated by the Google Earth Engine catalogue; WorldPop's own pages state none)
worldpop_2020.licence_checked: 2026-11-26, partly verified: confirm with WorldPop before redistributing derived rasters
worldpop_2020.citation: WorldPop (www.worldpop.org). Global2 R2025A population estimates, 2020, 1 km, constrained, UN-adjusted. University of Southampton. Labelled alpha by the publisher.
worldpop_2020.grade_notes: Release labelled alpha. Totals adjusted to UN WPP national estimates, so national totals are not independent of other sources. WorldPop asks that the data not be used to discriminate, exploit or surveil.

ghsl_smod_2020.name: GHS-SMOD R2023A, epoch 2020 (Degree of Urbanisation, level 2)
ghsl_smod_2020.citation: Schiavina M., Melchiorri M., Pesaresi M. (2023): GHS-SMOD R2023A - GHS settlement layers, application of the Degree of Urbanisation methodology (stage I) to GHS-POP R2023A and GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, multitemporal (1975-2030). European Commission, Joint Research Centre. doi:10.2905/A0DF7A6F-49DE-46EA-9BDE-563437A6E2BA
ghsl_smod_2020.native_grain: 30 arc-second raster (about 0.93 km), WGS84; JRC's resampling of the native 1 km Mollweide grid
ghsl_smod_2020.grade_notes: A classification derived from GHS-POP and GHS-BUILT-S, so it shares their modelling assumptions and is not independent of the population layer.

map_travel_2020.name: Malaria Atlas Project: travel time to healthcare, 2020 (motorised and walking-only)
map_travel_2020.publisher: Malaria Atlas Project; Weiss et al. 2020
map_travel_2020.citation: Weiss D.J., Nelson A., Vargas-Ruiz C.A., et al. (2020). Global maps of travel time to healthcare facilities. Nature Medicine 26, 1835-1838. doi:10.1038/s41591-020-1059-1
map_travel_2020.grade_notes: A least-cost model over a friction surface and a facility list. Facility coverage in the source list varies by country and is not quantified here. Travel time to the nearest facility says nothing about the facility's quality, staffing or cost.

unsd_census_dates.name: UNSD: 2020, 2010, 2000 and 1990 World Population and Housing Census Programme dates
unsd_census_dates.licence: UN web page; facts transcribed (dates are not copyrightable data, but the page carries no open licence)
unsd_census_dates.citation: United Nations Statistics Division, census dates by country, page updated 3 February 2026.
unsd_census_dates.grade_notes: A national fact spread over every cell in the country, so spatial fidelity is D by construction.

geoboundaries_adm0.name: geoBoundaries gbOpen ADM0 (simplified)
geoboundaries_adm0.licence: Set per country (see data/raw/geoboundaries/*-meta.json): UGA and COD ODbL 1.0; TZA and RWA CC BY 4.0; KEN and BDI public domain
geoboundaries_adm0.citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.
